name: 1Free.eu Free Web Hosting
free_limit: Free web hosting at 0 PLN forever: 1 GB disk, up to 5 MySQL databases (1 GB combined), 2 domains including the supplied subdomain, up to 10 email accounts per domain, and free SSL. Terms cap monthly transfer at 40 GB.
watch_out: The landing page advertises unlimited transfer, but Terms section 3.1 specifies 40 GB/month and section 4.1 allows account blocking for exceeded limits. Accounts inactive for at least one month may be deleted. Free VPS is only a 30-day trial, not included. Commercial-use permission is not explicitly established in the terms.
